notes: One card per admitted row, issued at the start of the week its test starts, from the champion bundle fitted at the latest quarterly origin on or before that week.
Outcomes are joined at the first weekly join on or after usable_after, typed by the weekly join's own rule.

The reliability report is built by the weekly join's own code: every card with a forecast is scored with its stored predictive, an abstained card on the forecast it withheld (flagged, not dropped); typed misses follow the card as issued.

Rolling coverage is over issued cards joined in the trailing eight weeks, against the interval for the observed estimate at the planned standard error. A flagged week is one whose report marks a cell drifted.
